Historical municipalities of Spain for a census year

Source: R/esp_get_munic_hist.R
esp_get_munic_hist.Rd

Returns the municipalities in force at the given census. All census maps come from the same partition of the territory, so they have no gaps or overlaps and can be aggregated (provinces, judicial districts, electoral districts...) without slivers.

Usage

esp_get_munic_hist(
  year,
  epsg = 4258,
  moveCAN = FALSE,
  include_nonmunicipal = TRUE,
  census_data = TRUE,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  update_cache = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

year

Census year, one of mhist_census_years().

epsg

EPSG code of the output (default 4258, ETRS89, as in mapSpain).

moveCAN

Position of the Canary Islands. FALSE (default) keeps their real position. TRUE moves them next to the Peninsula exactly as mapSpain::esp_move_can() does. A numeric vector c(lon, lat) adds an extra displacement, also as in mapSpain. When the islands are moved, draw the box that separates them with mapSpain::esp_get_can_box(), which matches this displacement.

include_nonmunicipal

If FALSE, drops the non-municipal territories (codes 53xxx, no_munic == 1).

census_data

If TRUE (default), adds the census figures of year from censos (municipality name, province, households, population...). If FALSE, returns only cod_ine, no_munic and the geometry.

cache_dir

Cache directory. If NULL, mhist_cache_dir() is used.

update_cache

If TRUE, downloads the geometries again.

verbose

If TRUE, shows download messages.

Value

An sf object with one row per municipality, or NULL (with a message) if the geometries cannot be downloaded.

Details

The geometries are downloaded from Zenodo the first time and stored in a cache directory (see mhist_cache_dir()).

Warning

the boundaries of most historical municipalities are an approximate reconstruction. See mapSpainHist-package.

Examples

# \donttest{
m1930 <- esp_get_munic_hist(1930, cache_dir = tempdir())
m1930_can <- esp_get_munic_hist(1930, moveCAN = TRUE, cache_dir = tempdir())
if (!is.null(m1930)) plot(sf::st_geometry(m1930))

if (!is.null(m1930_can) && requireNamespace("mapSpain", quietly = TRUE)) {
  plot(sf::st_geometry(m1930_can))
  plot(sf::st_geometry(mapSpain::esp_get_can_box()), add = TRUE)
}

# }
